item.title: China TCM doctor defies medical secrecy by carving 100 private prescriptions on her tombstone
item.description: A tombstone for a traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) doctor, engraved with 100 prescriptions she developed, has gone viral on mainland social media, with many people praising her generosity and noble character. The tombstone is in Xiping county, in central China’s Henan province. It commemorates Yuan Shufang, who practised TCM for eight decades and died in 2006 at the age of 97. item.title: Evolutionary threat: Chinese mountain birds lost nearly half genetic diversity in 50 years
item.description: Genetic diversity is nature’s insurance policy – an evolutionary safety net that provides the building blocks for natural selection. While members of the same species share a mostly identical genome, a sliver of unique genetic variants determines their individual traits. When this diversity erodes, and a population becomes more uniform, it could leave them vulnerable to the same threats and unable to adapt when new ones emerge. item.title: Hongkongers face chilliest days of the season as cold front brings wind and rain
item.description: Hongkongers will experience the chilliest days of autumn this coming week, with temperatures expected to drop to 16 degrees Celsius (61 Fahrenheit) as a cold front sweeps across the southern Chinese coast. The expected drop to 16 degrees on Friday and Saturday may mark the coldest days of the month, falling below the previous low of 17.5 degrees recorded in the city on November 10, according to records on the Hong Kong Observatory’s website.
